extracted.name: Tzatziki Sauce Batch IV
extracted.description: Great recipe for Tzatziki Sauce Batch IV.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup grated cucumber seeds removed and peeled
1-1/2 pounds plain yogurt I used siggi's
instruction_lines: Peel the cucumber. Slice the cucumber lengthwise and remove seeds with a spoon. Grate the cucumber and add to a paper towel to absorb the liquids.
Take the Greek seasoning and dill weed and add to the cucumber.
Stir the grated cucumber into the yogurt with the dill. incorporating it well.
When the ingredients are mixed put it in a bowl and set in the refrigerator till you are ready for it. Serve I hope you enjoy!!!
